headline: ENGLAND WINS THE WORLD CUP, BEATS WEST GERMANY 4-2 IN EXTRA TIME
dispatch: England claimed its first FIFA World Cup title at Wembley Stadium on Saturday, defeating West Germany 4-2 after extra time before a roaring crowd of nearly 97,000. Geoff Hurst scored a controversial third goal off the crossbar and then sealed the match with a fourth in the dying seconds. Captain Bobby Moore lifted the Jules Rimet Trophy and the streets of London erupted in celebration.
answer: England wins the FIFA World Cup at Wembley, 1966
